title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-125-25二模

items.zh: 骆驼会本能地适应干旱的沙漠环境。
items.en: Camels adapt to the arid desert environment by instinct.

items.zh: 这件丝绸睡衣摸起来无比柔软,值得回购。
items.en: The silk pajamas feel incredibly soft and are worth a repurchase.

items.zh: 倘若人工智能完全取代人类劳动,那岂不是每个人都面临失业的风险?
items.en: If AI were to completely replace human labor, wouldn’t everyone be at risk of unemployment?

items.zh: 这座拥有百年历史的图书馆坐落于市中心,馆藏丰富,读者可以在这里找到各种珍贵的书籍。
items.en: The century-old library is located in the city center, whose rich collection allows readers to access various rare books.
